title: eleocharis uniglumis
intro: Eleocharis uniglumis, commonly known as Spike-rush, is a type of aquatic plant species that belongs to the family Cyperaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly in treating various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and skin issues. The therapeutic actions of Eleocharis uniglumis include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which help in reducing pain and inflammation, as well as fighting off infections and protecting cells from damage. The bioactive constituents responsible for these properties include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, among others, which contribute to its potential health benefits.
